column9: initial state, min of 3 warm passes
MLX memory cap scaled to physical RAM (delta within 0.4% noise; kept as independently correct)
Voxtral delay 960->1440ms: no gain (+0.25%, within noise). Accurate-lane cost scales with audio processed, not with decode-call count
MLX relaxed buffer cache: +0.12% (noise). Reverted on safety, not metric — the hard cap guards against an OOM reboot
Nemotron chunk 160->320ms: -5.2%, first result outside noise. Fewer, larger MLX calls on the fast lane
Nemotron chunk 480ms: +101%, twice as slow. Curve is non-monotonic — 480 likely misaligns with the model geometry recorded as [56,1]
Re-confirm 320ms: 2.282 then 2.314, spread 1.4%. Win is real; noise band is wider than the baseline suggested
Nemotron chunk 240ms: +32%, worse than both 160 and 320. Curve has preferred values, not a direction
Nemotron chunk 640ms: +54%. Doubling hypothesis REFUTED — 640 should have been fast and is not. Curve is shape-dependent (likely Metal kernel specialisation), not arithmetic
